description: The brass key of the task form, pressed over the desk wood: bevelled border colors, a gradient face and two layered shadows.

florui.css: .scene { width: 220px; height: 70px; padding: 18px; background-color: #4b3220; } /* The tokens. The light comes from the top left everywhere: a highlight sits on the top and left edges of a raised thing, a shadow falls to its bottom and right, and a recessed thing is the other way round. */ .desk { /* Wood and leather */ --wood-deep: #2a1c12; --wood: #4b3220; --wood-light: #6d4a2e; --leather: #2c352f; --leather-light: #3a463e; --leather-edge: #1b211d; --stitch: #cdbb93; /* Brass */ --brass-light: #f0dc9c; --brass: #b8944d; --brass-dark: #6c5224; /* Paper and ink */ --paper: #f4ecd9; --paper-shade: #e5d9be; --paper-line: rgba(74, 112, 160, 0.26); --paper-margin: rgba(196, 71, 47, 0.5); --ink: #2a2118; --ink-soft: #6a5b47; --ink-faint: #9b8c74; /* Lamps */ --lamp-off: #3b3a34; --lamp-amber: #e8a838; --lamp-green: #78b25a; --lamp-red: #d65a3f; --lamp-blue: #5b95c9; /* Light and shade, always from the top left */ --lit: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); --lit-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); --shade-soft: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); --shade: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); --shade-deep: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65); /* Shape */ --radius-small: 4px; --radius: 8px; --radius-large: 14px; } .key { font-family: inherit; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #e9dcc0; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 var(--shade-deep); border: 1px solid; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); border-radius: var(--radius); background-color: #4f4637; background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #1c1710, 0 5px 6px var(--shade); } .key:hover { background-color: #5b5140; } .key:active { background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)); box-shadow: inset 1px 2px 4px var(--shade-deep), 0 1px 0 var(--lit-soft); } .key.accent { color: #2a1d08; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); border-color: var(--brass-light) var(--brass-dark) var(--brass-dark) var(--brass-light); background-color: var(--brass); background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #5a4219, 0 5px 6px var(--shade); } .key.accent:active { background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)); box-shadow: inset 1px 2px 4px rgba(60, 40, 8, 0.7), 0 1px 0 var(--lit-soft); } .key:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #1c1710, 0 0 0 2px var(--brass-light); }

classification.reason: The bevelled borders, the gradient face and the two shadows match Chromium to within 24 levels of 255 everywhere except the glyph edges: Chromium and this engine rasterize the same Open Sans differently (4.8% of the pixels differ by more, max error 174, all on the text and its pressed shadow). Geometry an exact match. Measured against desktop Chrome.
